component.name: SnapshotTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "RunPoller" end sub
sub RunPoller() port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.ObserveField("jobs", port) m.top.ObserveField("control", port) poller = NewSnapshotPoller(port) if m.top.jobs <> invalid then poller.setJobs(m.top.jobs)
' Every m.top access from this thread waits on the render ' thread, so learn about "stop" from the port, not by polling. running = true while running for each frame in poller.tick() m.top.frame = frame end for
msg = wait(50, port) msgType = type(msg) if msgType = "roUrlEvent" then frame = poller.handle(msg) if frame <> invalid then m.top.frame = frame else if msgType = "roSGNodeEvent" and msg.GetField() = "jobs" then jobs = msg.GetData() if jobs = invalid then jobs = [] poller.setJobs(jobs) else if msgType = "roSGNodeEvent" and msg.GetField() = "control" then running = LCase(msg.GetData()) <> "stop" end if end while poller.stopAll() end sub
